summary_1line: At Yudhishthira’s sacrifice Bhishma awards the first Arghya to Krishna, provoking Sisupala to angrily denounce the honor before the assembled kings.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the crowded sacrificial hall, Sahadeva offers a golden Arghya vessel to Krishna while kings and sages watch from every side.
Narada sits among the gathered sages, gazing over the assembly of kings as he realizes they are incarnate gods destined to destroy one another.
King Sisupala rises angrily in the royal assembly, pointing in accusation at Krishna while Bhishma and Yudhishthira sit before the gathered monarchs.
